generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
A copy of the valid Registration certificate of KPWD Class IV & above
The Earnest money deposit (EMD) in E cash
Copy of Valid Employees Provident Fund Registration Certificate

Copy of Valid GST Registration Certificate The amount put to tender is Exclusive of GST and the tenderer should quote Without GST. However, GST will be paid at Prevailing rate during billing. The increase in GST shall not be paid in extended period of contract for which reasons for delay are attributable to the contractor as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time

To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years period ie 2021-22 2022-23 2023-24 2024-25 & 2025-26 Achieved in at least TWO financial years an average annual financial turnover (in all Class of Civil Engineering Construction Works only) of Rs 20.46 Lakhs. (Usually not less than the estimated annual payment under this contract) (Updated to the FY in which the tenders are invited. Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10 percent year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited). The Turnover certificate issued by registered chartered Accountants along with UDIN

To qualify for award of this contract each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years period ie 2021-22 2022-23 2023-24 2024-25 & 2025-26 Satisfactorily completed (at least 90 percent of the contract value) as prime contractor at least one similar work Such as AME of canal/Providing Man power for water Management of Canal network works of value not less than Rs. 10.23 Lakhs (Usually not less than 50 percent estimated Value of Contract) (Updated to the FY in which the tender are invited. The value of the completed works shall be given weightage of 10 percent per year to bring them to the price level of FY in which the tenders are invited and the necessary work done certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer Equivalent officer of the concerned division

Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as Assessed available tender capacity is A x N x2.5 -B where A is Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years at 2026-27 price level updated to the financial year N is equal to 1 year. B Value, at 2026-27 price level (updated to the financial year in which the tender is invited) of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 1 year (period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited).
Copy of Valid ESI Registration Certificate
Any Modification/ corrections will be published in the kpp-portal.The bidders are advised to visit the kpp-portal web site regularly

Supply of manpower for water management of said canal works for filling of tank filling works. Supply of manpower for water management of Distry canal (Including Sundays General holidays), and when required by Nigam
There is No owner - labour relationship between Nigam & employees deployed by the bidder/ agency
Bidder shall be prepared to wait for payments due to lack of grants and administrative delays. For this reason, bidder shall not withhold wages to be paid to employees

Employees deployed for this service shall not be paid less than the kPP procurement minimum wage set forth in the Minimum Wage Act/ Labour act. Any revision in the minimum wages from the Dept of Labour shall be applicable

In the case of death of a contractor after executing / commencement of the work, his legal heir, if an eligible registered contractor and willing can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of work
The successful bidder shall provide the communication facility (i.e, mobile phone)
The agency should make their own arrangements for providing accommodation & conveyance to location, for their labor
The agency shall also be responsible and fulfill all statutory obligations under the statutory provisions such as PF etc, in respect of their personnel engaged under the contract
The agency shall engage the labor who is having their Aadhar card & bank account with IFSC code as per the statutory requirement of EPFO

The contractor shall comply with all relevant acts, rules by-laws, regulations and all other statutory requirements of local or other authorities, jurisdiction having over the areas and shall be responsible for the payment of all fees and other charges and giving & receiving of all necessary notices and keep the department informed of the said compliance with such acts, rules by laws, regulations, statutory requirements, payments made notice issued and received
The agency shall provide replacement for the labor, in event of his sickness absence or availing leave, National holidays, weekly off and his provision is provided in the scope of contract

Tenderer shall abide by the provisions of Employees provident fund act & nor their own enroll eligible employees working with them and remit the PF contribution to the authorities regularly and submit the proof of remittance
The contract shall not grant any claims to the labor engaged by the contractor any time at a future date
As the tender pertaining to AME nature, continuous man power being deputed at the site of work, the payment of such man power to be paid for the period of 12 months
Clause-33 payment: same clause -33read as para maintained in the as per GO FD 678 Exp-1/23Bengaluru Dated: 06.06.2025(Latest Modification)

The organization must adhere to all current regulations and make mandatory statutory deductions, submitting the details to the Division/Sub- Divisional Office on a monthly basis
The increase in GST shall not be paid in extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time

Successful bidders should execute the agreement within 20 days from the date of approval intimated. If the contractor fails to enter into the agreement within the said period, the EMD of the contractor shall be forfeited and action shall be initiated for banning to participate in the tender of KBJNL
The amount put to tender is Exclusive of GST and the tenderer should quote without GST. However GST will be paid at prevailing Rate during billing
All tenderers are required to strictly adhere to labor regulations when providing employees
All negetive tenders will be rejected, quotes cannot be lower than the tendered amount

The earnest money deposit may be forfeited a) if the Tenderer withdraws the Tender after tender opening during the period of tender validity b) if the Tenderer does not accept the correction of the Tender Price, pursuant to Clause 19 or c) in the case of a successful Tenderer, if the Tenderer fails within the specified time limit to i) sign the Agreement
The earnest money deposit of unsuccessful tenderers will be returned within 30 days of the end of the tender validity period specified in DTP
